limitations: Unresolved computed or indirect flows without target addresses are not represented as reference edges.
Thunk and external classifications are Ghidra FunctionManager observations; they do not resolve targetless calls.
Pseudocode and assembly are Ghidra-specific representations, not original source or Hopper-equivalent text.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
Static recovered pseudocode and data flow do not establish game runtime behavior.
Default recovered parameter types and calling conventions have low confidence; machine instructions and existing source contracts were reviewed separately.
The 4ebed985 previous supported binary was unavailable; this is direct inspection of the supplied new EXE, not a complete comparison to that missing build.
Full raw game instructions and pseudocode are retained only in local analysis files; this public summary contains identities and procedure ranges.
